correctness.rationale: The formal four-color arc classification proves all multipath faces and all S_n orbits are encoded by exactly the allowed leaf-equality partitions; pointwise simplex stabilizers give an honest regular CW quotient. The complete, explicitly listed eleven free-pair collapses (n>=4), four free-pair collapses plus verified sphere-surface condition (n=3), tetrahedral sphere plus two edges (n=2), and two intervals (n=1) establish the unrestricted homotopy classification. The embedded verifier enumerates direct labeled faces through n=5 and checks every coface of each collapsed lower cell; it is not used in place of the infinite structural proof.
